comparison.objective: Push a partly filled bottle to a line without tipping, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Contact placement and quasi-static push control, not tool alignment or retained rotary adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Bottle reaches a line without exceeding 30 degrees tilt; line tolerance, spill criteria, scoring, and reset details are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests stable pushing of a top-heavy container, unrelated to damper tuning.
